reuse.why: Consolidates selection into a new getMonthActionCategories used by every month-wide action and reuses the sheet's sum-amount cells and undoable/mutator wiring, but hand-rolls a #fixed regex instead of using shared/tags extractTagsFromText and re-derives the expense sign inline.

duplication.why: Removes the four copied category queries, but the income-outside-tracking check stays copied in every action (including the new one) and setLastMonthSpending repeats the expense sign inversion of the average actions.

placement.why: Selection logic and the new action live in server/budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts; tag parsing would sit better with shared/tags.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps: selection helper, new action and handler, flag, and tests.

maintainability.why: One selection function with a single explicit flag makes later rule changes easy, though the income rule and tag syntax are still decided outside it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: FIXED_GROUP_TAG regex in server/budget/actions.ts bypasses the existing tag parser extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: setLastMonthSpending's `cat.is_income === 1 ? net : 0 - net` is a reshaped form of the averages' `if (is_income === 0) avg *= -1`, and FIXED_GROUP_TAG re-implements tag matching from shared/tags.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains the includeHiddenCategories parameter and a conditional SQL hidden filter; all six month-wide actions call it, though each keeps its own income check outside the helper.
